<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_Chainsaw"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/chainsaw">

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Properties" name="Chainsaw properties"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ProductionUpdate" name="Production update"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_FirstSaw" name="First chainsaw"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ConfirmOrder" name="Order confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_Chainsaw">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Producer" name="Chainsaw Producer" processRef="Process_Producer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Properties" name="Chainsaw properties" sourceRef="SendTask_Properties" targetRef="StartEvent_Properties" messageRef="Msg_Properties"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ProductionUpdate" name="Production update" sourceRef="SendTask_Update" targetRef="Catch_ProductionUpdate" messageRef="Msg_ProductionUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_FirstSaw" name="First chainsaw" sourceRef="SendTask_FirstSaw" targetRef="Catch_FirstSaw" messageRef="Msg_FirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ConfirmOrder" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="SendTask_ConfirmOrder" targetRef="Catch_ConfirmOrder" messageRef="Msg_ConfirmOrder"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <!-- Producer process -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Producer" name="Chainsaw Production" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Properties" name="Chainsaw properties received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Properties" messageRef="Msg_Properties"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderParts" name="Order parts from various online sources (in parallel)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_PartsArrived" name="Parts arrived">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PartsArrived" messageRef="Msg_PartsArrived"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_Inspect" name="Inspect all parts manually">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Assemble" name="Assemble first chainsaw">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_FirstSaw" name="Send first chainsaw to customer" messageRef="Msg_FirstSaw">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ConfirmOrder" name="Order confirmation received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P7</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ConfirmOrder" messageRef="Msg_ConfirmOrder"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProduceRest" name="Produce remaining chainsaws of order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RestProduced" name="Remaining order produced">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P8</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- Event subprocess for regular production updates -->
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Updates" name="Regular production updates" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_UpdateTimer" name="Update timer" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_U1</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_Update"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>

      <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Update" name="Send production update to customer" messageRef="Msg_ProductionUpdate">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_U1</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_U2</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:sendTask>

      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_UpdateSent" name="Update sent">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_U2</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U1" sourceRef="StartEvent_UpdateTimer" targetRef="SendTask_Update"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U2" sourceRef="SendTask_Update" targetRef="EndEvent_UpdateSent"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Properties" targetRef="Task_OrderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P2" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="Catch_PartsArrived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P3" sourceRef="Catch_PartsArrived" targetRef="ManualTask_Inspect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P4" sourceRef="ManualTask_Inspect" targetRef="Task_Assemble"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P5" sourceRef="Task_Assemble" targetRef="SendTask_FirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P6" sourceRef="SendTask_FirstSaw" targetRef="Catch_ConfirmOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P7" sourceRef="Catch_ConfirmOrder" targetRef="Task_ProduceRest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P8" sourceRef="Task_ProduceRest" targetRef="EndEvent_RestProduced"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- Customer process -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer Order Handling" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Customer" name="Chainsaw needed">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Properties" name="Send chainsaw properties" messageRef="Msg_Properties">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Updates_Merge" name="Merge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_Wait" name="Wait for update or first chainsaw">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ProductionUpdate" name="Production update received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C7</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ProductionUpdate" messageRef="Msg_ProductionUpdate"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_FirstSaw" name="First chainsaw received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C6</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_FirstSaw" messageRef="Msg_FirstSaw"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Liked" name="Customer likes the saw?" default="Flow_C9">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C8</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ConfirmOrder" name="Confirm rest of order" messageRef="Msg_ConfirmOrder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Confirmed" name="Rest of order confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C10</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotLiked" name="Rest of order not placed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C9</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Customer" targetRef="SendTask_Properties"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="SendTask_Properties" targetRef="Gateway_Updates_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Gateway_Updates_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Wait"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="Gateway_Wait" targetRef="Catch_ProductionUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" sourceRef="Gateway_Wait" targetRef="Catch_FirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" sourceRef="Catch_FirstSaw" targetRef="Gateway_Liked"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C7" sourceRef="Catch_ProductionUpdate" targetRef="Gateway_Updates_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C8" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Liked" targetRef="SendTask_ConfirmOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C9" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Liked" targetRef="EndEvent_NotLiked"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C10" sourceRef="SendTask_ConfirmOrder" targetRef="EndEvent_Confirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
